name: Diffraction-Specific Approach
definition: An approach that breaks from traditional simulation of optical holographic interference by working backwards from the 3D image. The fringe is treated as being subsampled spatially into functional holographic elements ('hogels') and spectrally into an array of 'hogel vectors'.
summary: The Diffraction-Specific Approach calculates holograms by decomposing wavefields into hogel vectors and using texture-mapping hardware, distinguishing itself from conventional interference-based methods through explicit spectral subsampling and hardware-accelerated decoding.
